markets.title: Will the President be impeached before Oct 1, 2027?
markets.rules_primary: If the U.S. House of Representatives has passed a bill impeaching the President of the United States after Issuance and before Oct 1, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.

markets.title: Will the natural gas close price be above 3.600 USD/MMBtu on November 25, 2026 at 5:00 PM EST?
markets.rules_primary: If the close price of the 1-minute candlestick for natural gas on November 25, 2026 at 5:00 PM EST is above 3.600 USD/MMBtu, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary: The settlement value is rounded to the nearest 3 decimal places. When confirming the settlement value, note the close price for the 1-minute candlestick at a given time is the price at the end of the immediately preceding one-minute interval. For example, the candlestick timestamped 4:59 PM reflects trading during 4:59:00 PM to 4:59:59 PM and closes at 5:00:00 PM. If no data is published by the specified source agency for the specified time, then the most recently available published data will be used to resolve the market.

markets.title: Bitcoin price on Nov 25, 2026?
markets.rules_primary: If the simple average of the sixty seconds of CF Benchmarks' Bitcoin Real-Time Index (BRTI) before 5 PM EST is above 60749.99 at 5 PM EST on Nov 25, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary: Not all cryptocurrency price data is the same. While checking a source like Google or Coinbase may help guide your decision, the price used to determine this market is based on CF Benchmarks' corresponding Real Time Index (RTI). At the last minute before expiration, 60 RTI prices are collected. The official and final value is the average of these prices.
